blocks.zh: 附錄 11.4-11.5：前處理程序與最終處理詳解
blocks.en: Appendix 11.4-11.5: Pretreatment Processes and Final Treatment in Detail

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解水系統前處理（Pretreatment）四大類別：濁度/微粒去除、硬度/金屬離子去除、有機物/微生物控制、pH 與 CO<sub>2</sub> 管理
blocks.en: Understand the four categories of water system pretreatment: turbidity/particulate removal, hardness/metal ion removal, organics/microbial control, and pH and CO<sub>2</sub> management

blocks.zh: 掌握各前處理技術的原理、優缺點與選型邏輯：包括介質過濾、阻隔過濾、軟化、脫氣、奈米過濾、活性碳、UV 殺菌與氯處理
blocks.en: Know the principle, advantages, disadvantages and selection logic of each pretreatment technology: media filtration, barrier filtration, softening, degasification, nanofiltration, activated carbon, UV disinfection and chlorine treatment

blocks.zh: 了解鐵（Iron）、矽（Silica）、鋁（Aluminum）三種「問題離子」的特殊去除挑戰
blocks.en: Understand the specific removal challenges of the three "problem ions": iron, silica and aluminum

blocks.zh: 理解 pH 對碳酸鹽/重碳酸鹽/CO<sub>2</sub> 平衡的影響，以及對下游 RO 與離子交換系統設計的關鍵意義
blocks.en: Understand how pH affects the carbonate/bicarbonate/CO<sub>2</sub> equilibrium, and why this is critical for the design of downstream RO and ion exchange systems

blocks.zh: 掌握最終處理（Final Treatment）中離子交換與逆滲透的設計參數、組件配置、操作限制與效能指標
blocks.en: Know the design parameters, component configuration, operating limits and performance indicators of ion exchange and reverse osmosis in final treatment

blocks.zh: 能比較離子交換（IX）與逆滲透（RO）在製藥用水系統中的適用場景與優缺點
blocks.en: Be able to compare the applications, advantages and disadvantages of ion exchange (IX) and reverse osmosis (RO) in pharmaceutical water systems

blocks.zh: 11.4.1 Barrier Filtration Details（阻隔過濾詳述）
blocks.en: 11.4.1 Barrier Filtration Details

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：阻隔過濾的定位
blocks.en: Key concept: the role of barrier filtration

blocks.zh: 阻隔過濾在前處理中扮演的是「收尾清潔」角色，而非「主力去除」。原因很簡單：進水微粒量大，頻繁更換濾芯的成本太高。
blocks.en: In pretreatment, barrier filtration plays a "final cleanup" role, not a "main removal" role. The reason is simple: the feed water carries a large particulate load, so replacing cartridges frequently would be too costly.

blocks.zh: 典型配置是放在軟化器或活性碳之後、RO 之前，保護下游膜系統不被顆粒堵塞。
blocks.en: A typical configuration places it after the softener or activated carbon and before the RO, protecting the downstream membrane system from particulate fouling.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SDI < 5 的意義
blocks.en: Key point: what SDI < 5 means

blocks.zh: SDI（Silt Density Index，淤泥密度指數）是 RO 進水品質的關鍵指標。SDI < 5 是大多數 RO 膜製造商的最低要求，SDI < 3 為理想值。
blocks.en: SDI (Silt Density Index) is a key indicator of RO feed water quality. SDI < 5 is the minimum requirement of most RO membrane manufacturers, and SDI < 3 is the ideal value.

blocks.zh: 如果水中有不溶性矽或鐵，可能需要用絕對過濾精度 <1 μm 的濾芯或超過濾（UF）來達到此目標。
blocks.en: If the water contains insoluble silica or iron, cartridges with an absolute rating of <1 μm or ultrafiltration (UF) may be needed to reach this target.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：過濾如同門禁系統
blocks.en: Analogy: filtration as building access control

blocks.zh:
把水系統想成一棟大樓：
介質過濾（Media Filtration）= 大門口的保全，擋掉大部分訪客（粗顆粒）
阻隔過濾（Barrier Filtration）= 電梯前的門禁卡，只讓通過安檢的人進入（細顆粒把關）
RO 膜= 總裁辦公室的指紋鎖，最高等級過濾
blocks.en:
Think of the water system as a building:
Media filtration = the security guard at the front door, stopping most visitors (coarse particles)
Barrier filtration = the access card reader at the elevator, letting in only those who pass the check (fine-particle control)
RO membrane = the fingerprint lock on the CEO's office, the highest level of filtration

blocks.zh: 每一層都有成本，所以先用便宜的保全擋掉大部分，再用昂貴的門禁做精細把關。
blocks.en: Every layer has a cost, so use the cheap guard first to stop most of the load, then use the expensive access control for fine-grained protection.

blocks.zh: 11.4.2 Hardness and Metals — Ion Exchange（硬度與金屬離子交換）
blocks.en: 11.4.2 Hardness and Metals — Ion Exchange

blocks.zh: 核心概念：軟化的原理與必要性
blocks.en: Key concept: the principle and necessity of softening

blocks.zh: 軟化（Softening）是前處理中最基礎的步驟之一。目的很明確：去除鈣和鎂，防止下游 RO 膜或蒸餾器結垢（scaling）。
blocks.en: Softening is one of the most basic steps in pretreatment. Its purpose is clear: remove calcium and magnesium to prevent scaling of the downstream RO membrane or still.

blocks.zh: 原理是離子交換：樹脂上的鈉離子（Na+）與水中的鈣（Ca2+）和鎂（Mg2+）交換。因為樹脂對二價離子的親和力大於單價離子，所以交換自然發生。
blocks.en: The principle is ion exchange: sodium ions (Na+) on the resin are exchanged for calcium (Ca2+) and magnesium (Mg2+) in the water. Because the resin has a higher affinity for divalent ions than for monovalent ions, the exchange occurs naturally.

blocks.zh: 當所有交換位點都被佔滿，就需要用高濃度鹽水（brine）再生，把鈣鎂沖下來、重新裝上鈉離子。
blocks.en: When all the exchange sites are occupied, the resin must be regenerated with concentrated salt solution (brine), which strips off the calcium and magnesium and reloads the resin with sodium ions.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：軟化器如同停車場
blocks.en: Analogy: the softener as a parking lot

blocks.zh: 想像樹脂是一個停車場，每個車位上停著一台小車（Na+）。大型車輛（Ca2+, Mg2+）進來時，因為體積大（多價），會自動擠走小車佔據車位。
blocks.en: Imagine the resin as a parking lot with a small car (Na+) in every space. When large vehicles (Ca2+, Mg2+) arrive, their bulk (multivalence) means they automatically push out the small cars and take the spaces.

blocks.zh: 當車位全被大車佔滿（樹脂耗竭），管理員就用一大批小車（高濃度 NaCl）湧入，用數量優勢把大車逼走。這就是「再生」。
blocks.en: When every space is taken by large vehicles (resin exhausted), the attendant sends in a flood of small cars (concentrated NaCl) and uses sheer numbers to force the large vehicles out. This is "regeneration".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：三大「問題離子」
blocks.en: Key point: the three "problem ions"

blocks.zh: 鐵（Fe）：會變價！溶解態（Fe2+）遇氧氣變成不溶態（Fe3+）沉澱，堵塞膜系統。某些細菌還會以鐵為能源，產生鐵鏽狀膠體。
blocks.en: Iron (Fe): it changes valence. Dissolved iron (Fe2+) meets oxygen and becomes insoluble Fe3+, which precipitates and fouls the membrane system. Some bacteria also use iron as an energy source and produce rust-like gels.

blocks.zh: 矽（Si）：同時有離子態和膠體態。離子態軟化器可減少，膠體態需要 UF（<0.5 μm）或 NF/RO 去除。
blocks.en: Silica (Si): it occurs as both ionic and colloidal forms. A softener can reduce the ionic form; the colloidal form needs UF (<0.5 μm) or NF/RO for removal.

blocks.zh: 鋁（Al）：pH 6-8 之間最棘手，RO 只能去除約 80%。如果鋁是主要問題，可能需要「軟化 + pH 調整 + RO」的三步驟組合。
blocks.en: Aluminum (Al): it is most difficult between pH 6 and 8, where RO removes only about 80%. If aluminum is the main problem, a three-step combination of "softening + pH adjustment + RO" may be needed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼軟化器要放在 RO 之前而不是之後？如果不做軟化直接進 RO 會發生什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the softener placed before the RO rather than after it? What happens if the water goes to the RO without softening?

blocks.zh: 你的水源分析報告顯示鐵含量偏高且 pH 為 7.5，你會建議哪種前處理組合？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your source water analysis report shows high iron and a pH of 7.5. Which pretreatment combination would you recommend, and why?

blocks.zh: 11.4.3 Hardness and Metals — Other Processes（其他硬度去除程序）
blocks.en: 11.4.3 Hardness and Metals — Other Processes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：酸化脫氣法的邏輯
blocks.en: Key concept: the logic of acidification and degasification

blocks.zh: 這個程序的核心思路是：用酸把碳酸鹽/重碳酸鹽全部轉化為 CO<sub>2</sub> 氣體，然後用脫氣塔吹掉。
blocks.en: The core idea of this process is to use acid to convert all carbonate/bicarbonate to CO<sub>2</sub> gas, then blow it off in a degasifier.

blocks.zh: 步驟：加酸（pH 降到 3.8-4.2）→ 脫氣塔去除 CO<sub>2</sub>（>98%）→ 加鹼（pH 升到 8.0-8.5）→ 進 RO
blocks.en: Steps: add acid (pH down to 3.8-4.2) → remove CO<sub>2</sub> in the degasifier (>98%) → add caustic (pH up to 8.0-8.5) → feed to RO

blocks.zh: 這個方法可以取代軟化器，特別適合大流量（>50 gpm）或高硬度（>50 ppm）的場景。
blocks.en: This method can replace the softener and is particularly suitable for high flow rates (>50 gpm) or high hardness (>50 ppm).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：脫氣塔的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key point: microbial risk of the degasifier

blocks.zh: 脫氣塔會引入空氣，空氣中的細菌會進入水中。解決方案：
blocks.en: A degasifier introduces air, and bacteria in the air can enter the water. Solutions:

blocks.zh: 在進氣管加裝 HEPA 過濾器
blocks.en: Fit a HEPA filter on the air inlet

blocks.zh: 將脫氣塔設置在有微生物控制措施的位置（例如兩段式 RO 之間）
blocks.en: Locate the degasifier where microbial control measures exist (for example, between the two passes of a two-pass RO)

blocks.zh: 脫氣後的水通常收集在儲水槽中，可在此進行 TOC 去除和微生物控制
blocks.en: The degassed water is usually collected in a storage tank, where TOC removal and microbial control can be applied

blocks.zh: 奈米過濾典型去除率
blocks.en: Typical nanofiltration rejection rates

blocks.zh: 規律：分子量越大、價數越高，去除率越高。單價離子如 NaCl 只有 60%。
blocks.en: Pattern: the higher the molecular weight and the higher the valence, the higher the rejection. Monovalent ions such as NaCl are rejected at only 60%.

blocks.zh: 11.4.4 Organics and Microbiological Impurities（有機物與微生物雜質）
blocks.en: 11.4.4 Organics and Microbiological Impurities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：有機物與微生物的雙重來源
blocks.en: Key concept: two sources of organics and microorganisms

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調水系統的有機/微生物污染有兩個來源：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that organic/microbial contamination in a water system has two sources:

blocks.zh: 外部進入：隨原水帶入的有機物、細菌、熱原
blocks.en: Entering from outside: organics, bacteria and pyrogens carried in with the raw water

blocks.zh: 內部生長：系統內部滋生的微生物（特別是去除氯之後）
blocks.en: Growing inside: microorganisms that proliferate within the system (especially after chlorine removal)

blocks.zh: 這個「雙重來源」概念是水系統設計的基本思維框架。每個設備都要同時考慮「能去除多少外部污染」和「自身會製造多少內部污染」。
blocks.en: This "two sources" concept is the basic framework for water system design. For every piece of equipment, consider both how much external contamination it can remove and how much internal contamination it will generate itself.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：四類有機污染物
blocks.en: Key point: four categories of organic contaminants

blocks.zh: 特別注意：熱原不會被殺死細菌的條件破壞。即使水已經「無菌」，仍可能含有高量內毒素。這就是為什麼 WFI 系統需要多重屏障。
blocks.en: Note in particular: pyrogens are not destroyed by conditions that kill bacteria. Even when the water is "sterile", it may still contain high levels of endotoxin. This is why a WFI system needs multiple barriers.

blocks.zh: 11.4.4.4 Control of Microbiological Growth & Chlorine Management（微生物控制與氯管理）
blocks.en: 11.4.4.4 Control of Microbiological Growth & Chlorine Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念：微生物控制的多層策略
blocks.en: Key concept: a multi-layer strategy for microbial control

blocks.zh: 前處理系統的微生物控制不是靠單一方法，而是多層防禦：
blocks.en: Microbial control in a pretreatment system does not rely on a single method but on multiple layers of defense:

blocks.zh: 持續性控制：氯/氯胺（進水端）、UV（無氯環境）
blocks.en: Continuous control: chlorine/chloramine (feed end), UV (chlorine-free environment)

blocks.zh: 週期性控制：定期消毒（熱、化學、再生）
blocks.en: Periodic control: regular sanitization (heat, chemical, regeneration)

blocks.zh: 設計控制：避免死角、維持循環、溫度管理（<15°C 或 >80°C）
blocks.en: Design control: avoid dead legs, maintain circulation, temperature management (<15°C or >80°C)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：活性碳 -- 最大的矛盾
blocks.en: Key point: activated carbon, the biggest contradiction

blocks.zh: 活性碳是前處理中最矛盾的設備：它去除氯（保護下游膜），但同時也去除了抑制微生物的武器。結果就是：
blocks.en: Activated carbon is the most contradictory piece of equipment in pretreatment: it removes chlorine (protecting the downstream membranes) but also removes the very agent that suppresses microorganisms. The result:

blocks.zh: 碳床本身成為微生物的溫床（慢流速 + 暖溫 + 營養物質 = 完美培養基）
blocks.en: The carbon bed itself becomes a breeding ground for microorganisms (low flow velocity + warm temperature + nutrients = a perfect culture medium)

blocks.zh: 必須定期熱消毒：每日到每週 1-2 次，用 190°F（88°C）熱水或蒸汽
blocks.en: It must be thermally sanitized regularly: daily to once or twice weekly, with 190°F (88°C) hot water or steam

blocks.zh: 消毒後需要沖洗去除碳粉（fines）
blocks.en: After sanitization it must be rinsed to remove carbon fines

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼活性碳的位置和消毒計畫是水系統設計的關鍵決策之一。
blocks.en: This is why the location of the activated carbon and its sanitization program are among the key decisions in water system design.

blocks.zh: 氯胺 vs. 氯的去除差異
blocks.en: Difference in removing chloramine vs. chlorine

blocks.zh: 氯胺比氯難去除 3-6 倍！如果你的市政水源使用氯胺消毒：
blocks.en: Chloramine is 3-6 times harder to remove than chlorine. If your municipal source uses chloramine disinfection:

blocks.zh: 碳床需要 3-6 倍的接觸時間（床體更大或流速更低）
blocks.en: The carbon bed needs 3-6 times the contact time (a larger bed or a lower flow velocity)

blocks.zh: 去除後會產生銨離子（NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup>）和氨（NH<sub>3</sub>），需要後續離子交換去除
blocks.en: Removal produces ammonium ions (NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup>) and ammonia (NH<sub>3</sub>), which must be removed by downstream ion exchange

blocks.zh: 碳床可能需要放在軟化器之前（而非通常的之後），讓軟化器順便去除銨離子
blocks.en: The carbon bed may need to go before the softener (rather than the usual position after it), so that the softener also removes the ammonium

blocks.zh: 設計時務必先確認水源是使用氯還是氯胺消毒。
blocks.en: At the design stage, always first confirm whether the source water is disinfected with chlorine or chloramine.

blocks.zh: CO<sub>2</sub> 加壓停機法 -- 創新做法
blocks.en: CO<sub>2</sub> pressurization during shutdown: an innovative approach

blocks.zh: 這是一個聰明的節能方案：在停機期間用 CO<sub>2</sub> 加壓（2-4 bar），同時達成三個目標：
blocks.en: This is a clever energy-saving solution: during shutdown, pressurize with CO<sub>2</sub> (2-4 bar), which achieves three goals at once:

blocks.zh: 降低 pH 到 <5.5 -- 抑制微生物生長
blocks.en: Lowers the pH to <5.5, inhibiting microbial growth

blocks.zh: 溶解碳酸鈣等結垢物質 -- 清洗 RO 膜
blocks.en: Dissolves scale such as calcium carbonate, cleaning the RO membranes

blocks.zh: 節省停機期間的水和電力消耗
blocks.en: Saves water and power during the shutdown

blocks.zh: 啟動前只需將酸性水和溶解的鹽類沖掉即可。如果停機頻率與 RO 結垢頻率匹配，甚至可能省掉軟化器。
blocks.en: Before start-up, you only need to flush out the acidic water and dissolved salts. If the shutdown frequency matches the RO scaling frequency, the softener may even be eliminated.

blocks.zh: 11.4.5-11.4.6 pH, Carbon Dioxide & Feed Water pH（pH、二氧化碳與進水 pH 管理）
blocks.en: 11.4.5-11.4.6 pH, Carbon Dioxide & Feed Water pH

blocks.zh: 核心概念：pH-碳酸鹽平衡系統
blocks.en: Key concept: the pH-carbonate equilibrium system

blocks.zh: 這是水化學中最關鍵的平衡之一，直接影響水系統設計：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important equilibria in water chemistry and directly affects water system design:

blocks.zh: pH < 5.5：幾乎全部是 CO2（中性氣體），可以用脫氣塔去除
blocks.en: pH < 5.5: almost entirely CO2 (a neutral gas), which can be removed by a degasifier

blocks.zh: pH 5.5-8.3：CO2 和 HCO3- 共存
blocks.en: pH 5.5-8.3: CO2 and HCO3- coexist

blocks.zh: pH 8.3-10：幾乎全部是 HCO3-（離子），可以被 RO 或離子交換去除
blocks.en: pH 8.3-10: almost entirely HCO3- (ionic), which can be removed by RO or ion exchange

blocks.zh: pH > 10：主要是 CO32-
blocks.en: pH > 10: mainly CO32-

blocks.zh: 設計前處理系統時，要根據 pH 決定用什麼方法處理碳酸鹽系統。
blocks.en: When designing a pretreatment system, choose the method for handling the carbonate system according to the pH.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CO<sub>2</sub> 對製藥用水的致命影響
blocks.en: Key point: the critical effect of CO<sub>2</sub> on pharmaceutical water

blocks.zh: CO<sub>2</sub> 是一個「隱形殺手」：
blocks.en: CO<sub>2</sub> is a "silent killer":

blocks.zh: 它可以直接穿透 RO 膜（因為是中性分子，不帶電荷）
blocks.en: It passes straight through RO membranes (it is a neutral molecule with no charge)

blocks.zh: 微量 CO<sub>2</sub> 就能讓純水 pH 從 7.0 降到 5.5，電導率從 0.1 μS 升到 1 μS
blocks.en: A trace of CO<sub>2</sub> can lower the pH of pure water from 7.0 to 5.5 and raise the conductivity from 0.1 μS to 1 μS

blocks.zh: 這可能導致水質無法通過 USP 電導率測試
blocks.en: This may cause the water to fail the USP conductivity test

blocks.zh: 對兩段式 RO 系統，即使微量 CO<sub>2</sub> 也可能無法產出 <1 μS 的水
blocks.en: In a two-pass RO system, even a trace of CO<sub>2</sub> may prevent production of water below 1 μS

blocks.zh: 因此，了解進水 pH 和 CO<sub>2</sub> 含量是系統設計的第一步。
blocks.en: So knowing the feed water pH and CO<sub>2</sub> content is the first step in system design.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：pH 調整如同交通疏導
blocks.en: Analogy: pH adjustment as traffic management

blocks.zh: 想像碳酸鹽系統中的三種形態（CO<sub>2</sub>、HCO<sub>3</sub><sup>-</sup>、CO<sub>3</sub><sup>2-</sup>）是三條道路上的車流。
blocks.en: Imagine the three forms in the carbonate system (CO<sub>2</sub>, HCO<sub>3</sub><sup>-</sup>, CO<sub>3</sub><sup>2-</sup>) as traffic on three roads.

blocks.zh: 加酸 = 把所有車都引導到「CO2 高速公路」上，然後用脫氣塔這個「出口匝道」把車送走。缺點：出口擁擠時（高 CO2），部分車輛會「溜進」RO 系統。
blocks.en: Adding acid = steering all the cars onto the "CO2 highway", then sending them away via the "exit ramp" of the degasifier. Drawback: when the exit is congested (high CO2), some cars "slip into" the RO system.

blocks.zh: 加鹼 = 把車都引導到「碳酸鹽大道」上，RO 膜可以攔截離子態的車輛。缺點：太多車聚集可能「堵車」（結垢）。
blocks.en: Adding caustic = steering the cars onto "carbonate avenue", where the RO membrane can stop the ionic vehicles. Drawback: too many cars gathering can cause a "traffic jam" (scaling).

blocks.zh: 因此多數藥廠選擇「軟化器」先去除容易結垢的鈣鎂，再讓 RO 處理剩餘離子。
blocks.en: So most pharmaceutical plants choose a softener to remove the scale-prone calcium and magnesium first, then let the RO handle the remaining ions.

blocks.zh: 你的進水 pH 為 7.2，總硬度 200 ppm，CO<sub>2</sub> 測試為 35 ppm。這對下游 RO 系統會造成什麼挑戰？你會建議什麼前處理組合？
blocks.en: Your feed water has a pH of 7.2, total hardness of 200 ppm and a CO<sub>2</sub> test result of 35 ppm. What challenges will this create for the downstream RO system? Which pretreatment combination would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議在 RO 進水前將 pH 調到 8.0-8.5？這樣做有什麼潛在風險？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend adjusting the pH to 8.0-8.5 before the RO feed? What potential risks does this carry?

blocks.zh: 11.5 Final Treatment: Ion Exchange for Purified Water（最終處理：離子交換）
blocks.en: 11.5 Final Treatment: Ion Exchange for Purified Water

blocks.zh: 核心概念：離子交換的完整去離子化
blocks.en: Key concept: complete deionization by ion exchange

blocks.zh: 前處理中的「軟化」只用陽離子交換（Na 型），而最終處理中的離子交換是完整的去離子化：
blocks.en: The "softening" in pretreatment uses only cation exchange (Na form), whereas ion exchange in final treatment is complete deionization:

blocks.zh: 陽離子交換（H+ 型）：Ca2+, Mg2+, Na+ → H+（水變成含酸的溶液）
blocks.en: Cation exchange (H+ form): Ca2+, Mg2+, Na+ → H+ (the water becomes an acidic solution)

blocks.zh: 陰離子交換（OH- 型）：SO42-, Cl-, HCO3- → OH-
blocks.en: Anion exchange (OH- form): SO42-, Cl-, HCO3- → OH-

blocks.zh: H+ + OH- → H<sub>2</sub>O（純水）
blocks.en: H+ + OH- → H<sub>2</sub>O (pure water)

blocks.zh: 這就是「去離子」（Deionization / DI）的基本原理。
blocks.en: This is the basic principle of deionization (DI).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Two-Bed vs. Mixed-Bed 的選擇
blocks.en: Key point: choosing between two-bed and mixed-bed

blocks.zh: Two-bed（雙床）：再生簡單，適合大量處理。逆流再生型可產出 0.2 μS/cm 的水，化學品用量減半。
blocks.en: Two-bed: simple regeneration, suited to high throughput. A counter-current regenerated unit can produce 0.2 μS/cm water with half the chemical consumption.

blocks.zh: Mixed-bed（混床）：產出水質最好（可達 0.055 μS/cm，接近純水理論值 0.055），但再生複雜（需要分離、混合樹脂）。
blocks.en: Mixed-bed: gives the best product water quality (down to 0.055 μS/cm, close to the theoretical value for pure water of 0.055), but regeneration is complex (the resins must be separated and remixed).

blocks.zh: 常見配置是 RO + Mixed-bed polisher：RO 去除 90-99% 離子，混床做最後把關。
blocks.en: A common configuration is RO + mixed-bed polisher: the RO removes 90-99% of the ions and the mixed bed provides the final safeguard.

blocks.zh: Counter-Current vs. Co-Current 再生
blocks.en: Counter-current vs. co-current regeneration

blocks.zh: 逆流再生（Counter-Current）是現代離子交換的優選：
blocks.en: Counter-current regeneration is the preferred choice in modern ion exchange:

blocks.zh: 化學品用量減少約 50%
blocks.en: Chemical consumption reduced by about 50%

blocks.zh: 產出水質更高
blocks.en: Higher product water quality

blocks.zh: 原理：再生液從出水端進入，最後接觸最乾淨的樹脂層，確保出水端永遠是最新鮮的樹脂
blocks.en: Principle: the regenerant enters from the outlet end and contacts the cleanest resin layer last, ensuring the outlet end always has the freshest resin

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Mixed-bed 如同咖啡混合豆
blocks.en: Analogy: mixed-bed as a coffee blend

blocks.zh: Two-bed 像是先喝一杯酸咖啡（陽離子交換後的酸性水），再喝一杯鹼咖啡（陰離子交換後的鹼性水），最後在嘴裡中和。
blocks.en: A two-bed is like first drinking a cup of sour coffee (the acidic water after cation exchange), then a cup of bitter alkaline coffee (the alkaline water after anion exchange), and neutralizing them in your mouth.

blocks.zh: Mixed-bed 像是把兩種咖啡豆磨在一起沖泡：每一口都同時中和酸鹼，所以每一口的品質都極高。這就是為什麼 Mixed-bed 的產出水質遠優於 Two-bed。
blocks.en: A mixed-bed is like grinding the two kinds of beans together and brewing them as one: every sip neutralizes acid and base at the same time, so every sip is of very high quality. This is why mixed-bed product water is far better than two-bed.

blocks.zh: 11.5.1.4-11.5.1.10 Ion Exchange Components, Regeneration & Sanitization（離子交換組件、再生與消毒）
blocks.en: 11.5.1.4-11.5.1.10 Ion Exchange Components, Regeneration & Sanitization

blocks.zh: 重點提示：分配器是隱藏的關鍵
blocks.en: Key point: the distributor is the hidden critical part

blocks.zh: Distributor（分配器）是離子交換槽中最容易被忽略但最關鍵的零件：
blocks.en: The distributor is the part of an ion exchange vessel that is most easily overlooked yet most critical:

blocks.zh: 功能：防止樹脂洩漏 + 均勻分配水流
blocks.en: Function: prevent resin leakage + distribute the water flow evenly

blocks.zh: 材質選擇：SS、PVC、CPVC、PP、PVDF
blocks.en: Material options: SS, PVC, CPVC, PP, PVDF

blocks.zh: 破裂的分配器 = 災難：大量樹脂洩漏、修復耗時、可能汙染下游系統
blocks.en: A broken distributor = disaster: large resin leakage, time-consuming repair, and possible contamination of downstream systems

blocks.zh: 設計時要特別注意結構強度，定期檢查是維護重點。
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to structural strength at the design stage; regular inspection is a maintenance priority.

blocks.zh: 管材選擇的取捨
blocks.en: Trade-offs in piping material selection

blocks.zh: PVC/CPVC：低成本、耐腐蝕，但有機物溶出較多
blocks.en: PVC/CPVC: low cost and corrosion resistant, but higher leaching of organics

blocks.zh: PP/PVDF：有機物溶出低，管路設計可接近衛生級不鏽鋼焊接，但成本更高
blocks.en: PP/PVDF: low organic leaching, and piping can be designed close to sanitary stainless steel welded practice, but at higher cost

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼：結構強、可熱消毒，但接觸酸鹼有腐蝕風險
blocks.en: Stainless steel: structurally strong and thermally sanitizable, but at risk of corrosion on contact with acid and caustic

blocks.zh: 選擇取決於預算、產品水質要求、以及消毒方式。如果需要熱消毒 → 不鏽鋼；如果重視低溶出 → PVDF。
blocks.en: The choice depends on budget, product water quality requirements and the sanitization method. If thermal sanitization is needed → stainless steel; if low leaching is the priority → PVDF.

blocks.zh: 微生物控制與再生頻率
blocks.en: Microbial control and regeneration frequency

blocks.zh: 離子交換系統的微生物控制策略是「以再生代替消毒」：酸鹼再生液（極端 pH）本身就能殺菌。
blocks.en: The microbial control strategy of an ion exchange system is "regeneration in place of sanitization": the acid and caustic regenerants (extreme pH) are themselves bactericidal.

blocks.zh: 但隨著樹脂耗竭，pH 趨近中性，加上有機物沉積，微生物就會開始增長。因此：
blocks.en: But as the resin becomes exhausted, the pH approaches neutral, and with deposited organics, microorganisms begin to grow. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 沒有 UV 輔助的系統：再生頻率必須考量微生物因素，不能只看離子耗竭程度
blocks.en: Systems without UV support: regeneration frequency must take microbial factors into account, not just the degree of ion exhaustion

blocks.zh: 有 UV + 微過濾的系統（polishing）：可以延長再生週期到數週
blocks.en: Systems with UV + microfiltration (polishing): the regeneration cycle can be extended to several weeks

blocks.zh: 核心概念：On-site vs. Off-site 再生
blocks.en: Key concept: on-site vs. off-site regeneration

blocks.zh: 這是離子交換系統設計的第一個決策點：
blocks.en: This is the first decision point in ion exchange system design:

blocks.zh: 11.5.2 Reverse Osmosis (RO) for High Purity Water Applications（高純水用逆滲透系統）
blocks.en: 11.5.2 Reverse Osmosis (RO) for High Purity Water Applications

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Brine Seal 的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key point: microbial risk of the brine seal

blocks.zh: 傳統 RO 膜元件前端的 brine seal（鹽水密封圈）會在膜與壓力容器之間創造滯留水區，成為微生物溫床。
blocks.en: The brine seal at the front of a conventional RO membrane element creates a stagnant water zone between the membrane and the pressure vessel, which becomes a breeding ground for microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 製藥級 RO 系統應優先選用無 brine seal 的膜（loose wrap / full fit），允許少量受控水流通過膜與容器之間，消除滯留區。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical-grade RO systems should preferably use membranes without a brine seal (loose wrap / full fit), which allow a small controlled flow of water between the membrane and the vessel and eliminate the stagnant zone.

blocks.zh: 兩段式 RO（Product Staged）的架構
blocks.en: Architecture of a two-pass RO (product staged)

blocks.zh: 單段 RO 通常無法達到 USP 純水標準。兩段式 RO 的水路：
blocks.en: A single-pass RO usually cannot meet the USP purified water standard. The water path of a two-pass RO:

blocks.zh: 原水 → 前處理 → 第一段 RO（去除 90-99%）→ 第二段 RO（再去除 90-99%）→ 產品水
blocks.en: Raw water → pretreatment → first-pass RO (removes 90-99%) → second-pass RO (removes a further 90-99%) → product water

blocks.zh: 兩段式 RO 的產出水電阻率通常可達 0.5 MΩ/cm 以上，足以符合 USP Purified Water。部分系統甚至能通過 Stage 1 電導率測試（可線上量測）。
blocks.en: The product water resistivity of a two-pass RO can usually reach above 0.5 MΩ/cm, enough to meet USP Purified Water. Some systems can even pass the Stage 1 conductivity test (measurable online).

blocks.zh: RO 系統的關鍵監測參數
blocks.en: Key monitoring parameters for an RO system

blocks.zh: 進水/產水電導率 → 計算即時去除率
blocks.en: Feed/product conductivity → calculate real-time rejection

blocks.zh: 產水流量 + 廢水流量 → 回收率
blocks.en: Product flow + reject flow → recovery

blocks.zh: 進水溫度 → 影響膜通量
blocks.en: Feed temperature → affects membrane flux

blocks.zh: 壓力（進水/濃水/產水） → 膜狀態指標
blocks.en: Pressure (feed/concentrate/product) → indicator of membrane condition

blocks.zh: 膜間壓力 + 電導率 → 結垢和劣化指標
blocks.en: Differential pressure across membranes + conductivity → indicators of fouling and degradation

blocks.zh: ORP / 殘氯 → 保護 TFC 膜
blocks.en: ORP / residual chlorine → protect the TFC membrane

blocks.zh: 所有儀表必須校正且可追溯至 NIST。
blocks.en: All instruments must be calibrated and traceable to NIST.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：RO 膜材質的選擇
blocks.en: Key concept: choosing the RO membrane material

blocks.zh: 這是 RO 系統設計的第一個也是最重要的決策：
blocks.en: This is the first and most important decision in RO system design:

blocks.zh: 結論：TFC 膜是製藥的主流選擇，但前提是必須先去除氯。
blocks.en: Conclusion: TFC membranes are the mainstream choice in pharmaceutical use, provided that chlorine is removed first.

blocks.zh: 11.5.2.4-11.5.2.8 RO Limitations, Scaling, Cleaning & Performance（RO 限制、結垢、清洗與效能）
blocks.en: 11.5.2.4-11.5.2.8 RO Limitations, Scaling, Cleaning & Performance

blocks.zh: 核心概念：RO 的四大限制
blocks.en: Key concept: the four main limitations of RO

blocks.zh: CO2 穿透：中性分子直接通過膜，影響產水電導率和 pH
blocks.en: CO2 passage: a neutral molecule passes straight through the membrane, affecting product conductivity and pH

blocks.zh: 無法 100% 去除：始終需要濃水排放（通常 25%），且極低分子量有機物難去除
blocks.en: Cannot remove 100%: a concentrate bleed (typically 25%) is always needed, and very low molecular weight organics are hard to remove

blocks.zh: 不能持續高溫運行：常溫運行有微生物生長風險，這是 RO 在 WFI 應用中最大的限制
blocks.en: Cannot run continuously at high temperature: operation at ambient temperature carries a risk of microbial growth, which is the biggest limitation of RO in WFI applications

blocks.zh: O-ring 洩漏風險：膜元件之間的密封圈鬆脫會導致水質急劇下降
blocks.en: O-ring leakage risk: loosened seals between membrane elements can cause a sharp drop in water quality

blocks.zh: 重點提示：清洗頻率是前處理品質的指標
blocks.en: Key point: cleaning frequency is an indicator of pretreatment quality

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：如果前處理系統設計和運作正常，RO 清洗頻率不應超過每年 4 次。
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly: if the pretreatment system is properly designed and operated, RO cleaning should not be needed more than 4 times a year.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 RO 清洗頻率明顯超過這個標準，問題不在 RO 本身，而在前處理系統。需要回頭檢查：
blocks.en: If your RO cleaning frequency clearly exceeds this standard, the problem is not the RO itself but the pretreatment system. Go back and check:

blocks.zh: 軟化器是否正常再生？（硬度結垢）
blocks.en: Is the softener regenerating properly? (hardness scaling)

blocks.zh: 碳床是否有效去除有機物？（有機物汙堵）
blocks.en: Is the carbon bed effectively removing organics? (organic fouling)

blocks.zh: 微粒過濾是否到位？（SDI > 3？）
blocks.en: Is particulate filtration adequate? (SDI > 3?)

blocks.zh: 進水 pH 是否在正確範圍？
blocks.en: Is the feed water pH in the correct range?

blocks.zh: RO 效能關鍵計算
blocks.en: Key RO performance calculations

blocks.zh:
Recovery (回收率) = 產水流量 / 進水流量 x 100%
  典型值：75%（小型可能更低，大型可達 85%）

Salt Rejection (鹽去除率) = (1 - 產水電導率/進水電導率) x 100%
  單段：90-99%
  兩段串聯：99-99.9%

SDI (淤泥密度指數) 目標值：
  理想值 < 3
  最大可接受值 < 5
blocks.en:
Recovery = product flow / feed flow × 100%
  Typical value: 75% (may be lower for small units, up to 85% for large ones)

Salt Rejection = (1 - product conductivity / feed conductivity) × 100%
  Single pass: 90-99%
  Two passes in series: 99-99.9%

SDI (Silt Density Index) targets:
  Ideal < 3
  Maximum acceptable < 5

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：RO 清洗如同汽車保養
blocks.en: Analogy: RO cleaning as car maintenance

blocks.zh: 酸洗 = 用除鏽劑清除鈣鎂結垢（如同去除車底盤鏽蝕）
blocks.en: Acid cleaning = using a rust remover to clear calcium and magnesium scale (like removing rust from the underbody)

blocks.zh: 鹼洗 = 用清潔劑去除有機物和淤泥（如同清洗引擎油垢）
blocks.en: Alkaline cleaning = using a detergent to remove organics and silt (like cleaning engine oil grime)

blocks.zh: 通常兩者依序執行確保徹底清洗。如果你的車需要每個月進廠大修，不是車的問題，而是路的問題（前處理不佳）。
blocks.en: Usually the two are performed in sequence to ensure thorough cleaning. If your car needs a major overhaul every month, the problem is not the car but the road (poor pretreatment).

blocks.zh: 你的兩段式 RO 系統產水電導率突然從 1.2 μS/cm 升到 8 μS/cm，可能的原因是什麼？你會先檢查什麼？
blocks.en: The product conductivity of your two-pass RO system suddenly rises from 1.2 μS/cm to 8 μS/cm. What are the possible causes, and what would you check first?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 指出 RO 在 WFI 應用中使用有限？如果你的公司想用兩段式 RO 取代蒸餾產 WFI，需要額外解決什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE point out that RO has limited use in WFI applications? If your company wants to replace distillation with a two-pass RO to produce WFI, what additional problems must be solved?

blocks.zh: 一個 RO 系統在 85% 回收率下運行，與 75% 回收率相比，對膜壽命和清洗頻率會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: An RO system runs at 85% recovery instead of 75%. What effect will this have on membrane life and cleaning frequency?

blocks.zh: Section Summary（本節總結）
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 學習重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Learning Points Review

blocks.zh: 本節核心心得
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 前處理決定最終處理的壽命：前處理做得好，RO 膜用 3-5 年；做不好，每季就要清洗甚至更換。
blocks.en: Pretreatment determines the life of final treatment: with good pretreatment, RO membranes last 3-5 years; with poor pretreatment, they need cleaning or even replacement every quarter.

blocks.zh: 水源分析是起點：井水 vs. 地表水、硬度、鐵/矽/鋁含量、氯 vs. 氯胺——這些決定了整個前處理的架構。
blocks.en: Source water analysis is the starting point: well water vs. surface water, hardness, iron/silica/aluminum content, chlorine vs. chloramine: these determine the whole pretreatment architecture.

blocks.zh: 氯的矛盾：要靠氯控制微生物，但氯又會破壞下游膜和樹脂。去除氯的時機和方法是關鍵設計決策。
blocks.en: The chlorine contradiction: chlorine is relied on to control microorganisms, yet it damages downstream membranes and resins. The timing and method of chlorine removal are key design decisions.

blocks.zh: CO2 不可忽視：它穿透 RO 膜、影響電導率、增加離子交換負擔。pH 管理直接影響 CO2 行為。
blocks.en: CO2 cannot be ignored: it passes through RO membranes, affects conductivity and adds load to ion exchange. pH management directly affects CO2 behavior.

blocks.zh: IX vs. RO 的選擇：IX 化學品處理複雜但流量彈性大；RO 減少化學品但有廢水和微生物問題。多數現代系統採用 RO + IX polisher 組合。
blocks.en: Choosing between IX and RO: IX involves complex chemical handling but offers flexible capacity; RO reduces chemicals but brings waste water and microbial issues. Most modern systems use an RO + IX polisher combination.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習 Comprehensive Practice
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice

blocks.zh: 你被要求設計一套製藥純化水系統，水源條件如下：
blocks.en: You are asked to design a pharmaceutical purified water system with the following source water conditions:

blocks.zh: 市政自來水，使用氯胺消毒（0.8 ppm）
blocks.en: Municipal tap water, disinfected with chloramine (0.8 ppm)

blocks.zh: 硬度：180 ppm as CaCO<sub>3</sub>
blocks.en: Hardness: 180 ppm as CaCO<sub>3</sub>

blocks.zh: 鐵：0.3 ppm（可溶態）
blocks.en: Iron: 0.3 ppm (soluble)

blocks.zh: 需求流量：40 gpm
blocks.en: Required flow rate: 40 gpm

blocks.zh: 請規劃完整的前處理 + 最終處理流程，說明每個單元的選型理由和關鍵設計參數。
blocks.en: Plan the complete pretreatment + final treatment train, and explain the selection rationale and key design parameters for each unit.
